result:
I’d make people less able to see other people as less than human.

Not by removing pain, conflict, or difference — but by making dehumanization harder and empathy harder to ignore. If people could more reliably recognize shared fear, dignity, and need in one another, almost everything else would begin to change.

message.content:
I’d make people less able to see other people as less than human.

Not by removing pain, conflict, or difference — but by making dehumanization harder and empathy harder to ignore. If people could more reliably recognize shared fear, dignity, and need in one another, almost everything else would begin to change.
